features.name: Ask every AI at once
features.description: A single prompt is dispatched to all enabled AI providers simultaneously. Responses are collected as each one finishes.
features.notes: asyncio fan-out; per-provider timeout; one failing provider can't abort the run

features.name: Unified synthesis
features.description: All successful responses are merged into one superior answer that preserves every table and code block from the source answers.
features.notes: Synthesised by local Gemma 4 26B, with ChatGPT as fallback

features.name: Chain mode (progressive refinement)
features.description: Each AI improves on the previous AI's answer in sequence, building a steadily better response.
features.notes: routing_mode = chain

features.name: Iterative mode (multi-round)
features.description: NEXUS loops the dispatch-and-synthesise cycle up to 3 times, refining the answer each round for hard questions.
features.notes: routing_mode = iterative; capped at 3 rounds

features.name: Live streaming answers
features.description: Watch each provider's answer arrive in real time, then the final synthesis, rather than waiting for everything at once.
features.notes: Server-Sent Events at /synthesize/stream with thinking badges + heartbeats

features.name: Reasoning depth control
features.description: Pick how hard the models think per request: Fast, Balanced, Thinking, or Deep Reasoning. Applied globally or per provider.
features.notes: Mode capability auto-detected per model; deep mode raises timeouts up to 10x

features.name: Pick which AIs answer
features.description: Run against all providers, or hand-pick a subset for a given question.
features.notes: provider_ids selector in the Orchestrator

features.name: 26 expert personas
features.description: Pose a question to AIs role-playing famous domain experts (e.g. a physicist, an economist, a legal scholar), each with its own reasoning style and vocabulary.
features.notes: config/personas.json — 26 built-in, locked; modelled on real experts with inspiration credit

features.name: Multi-persona panels
features.description: Assign different personas to different providers for the same query, then synthesise their contrasting perspectives.
features.notes: persona_map: provider_id -> system prompt

features.name: Create your own experts
features.description: Define custom personas through the Panel Designer (identity, mental models, skepticism lens, vocabulary) — the system prompt is auto-generated.
features.notes: Saved to config/user_personas.json via POST /personas

features.name: Panel presets
features.description: Save and reuse favourite combinations of experts as named panels.
features.notes: Expert Panel -> Presets tab

features.name: Score each AI's answer
features.description: An impartial judge AI rates every response 1-10 on Clarity, Accuracy, and Depth, and names the best answer.
features.notes: enable_judge; default judge = Groq

features.name: Rigorous DeepEval scoring
features.description: Structured G-Eval scoring runs three metrics per response with written reasons, for defensible, repeatable evaluation.
features.notes: scorer.mode = deepeval (default); falls back to simple if the judge fails

features.name: Benchmark suites
features.description: Run a fixed battery of test prompts against any set of providers and compare their scores side by side.
features.notes: Bench tab; starter suite seeded; 5 cases x 4 provider runs recorded

features.name: Catch model regressions
features.description: Scores are tracked over time so a swapped or upgraded model that quietly got worse is caught.
features.notes: bench_provider_runs history

features.name: Best-model recommendation
features.description: Ask NEXUS which provider is best for a use case; it answers from accumulated benchmark history.
features.notes: GET /bench/recommend — returns ranked providers by mean score

features.name: Autonomous news monitoring
features.description: Scout crawls configured topics (AI news and more) on a schedule with no human intervention, day and night.
features.notes: APScheduler; default 6h, per-topic override; 13,000+ items collected

features.name: Multi-source crawling
features.description: Pulls from RSS feeds, Reddit, and Hacker News in one cycle.
features.notes: 8,500 RSS + 4,708 Reddit + 36 HN items to date

features.name: Duplicate suppression
features.description: Near-identical stories from different sources are collapsed so the digest doesn't repeat itself.
features.notes: rapidfuzz fuzzy matching at 85% threshold

features.name: AI-written daily digest
features.description: Each cycle produces a concise, readable digest synthesised by the AI chain, saved to the DB and as a Word document.
features.notes: 99 digests stored; .docx auto-generated per topic per day

features.name: Custom topics + OPML import
features.description: Add and manage your own research topics; bulk-import feeds from any RSS reader's OPML export.
features.notes: Scout -> Manage Topics; POST /scout/import/opml

features.name: Powers TubeScout
features.description: Scout's topic engine also backs the TubeScout project's YouTube channel tracking.
features.notes: tubescout_youtube topics: 726 + 1,365 items

features.name: Batch prompt runs
features.description: Submit a list of prompts and have NEXUS run them all through the synthesis pipeline in one job, with per-prompt logs.
features.notes: Batch & Schedule tab; per_prompt / per_model log modes

features.name: Scheduled jobs
features.description: Register recurring prompt batches to run automatically (once, interval, daily, or cron).
features.notes: POST /schedule/jobs; APScheduler-backed

features.name: Curate & export
features.description: Save the best answers, evaluations, or raw responses to a knowledge library, or download them as a file.
features.notes: Curate & Export tab; appends to knowledge JSONL + auto-ingests to RAG

features.name: RAG knowledge augmentation
features.description: Optionally enrich answers with context retrieved from NEXUS's own knowledge base.
features.notes: ChromaDB vector store; 'Augment with Knowledge Base (RAG)' toggle

features.name: Session history
features.description: Every synthesis is saved with its prompt, answer, providers used, and timing, and can be reloaded.
features.notes: 5,000+ sessions stored; GET /history, GET /sessions

features.name: Shared intelligence API
features.description: Any QI project can call NEXUS for multi-AI synthesis, the daily digest, or a model recommendation, over a stable REST contract.
features.notes: Integrates with Maia, Naya, FileHQ, OpenClaw

features.name: Registry-driven CORS
features.description: Allowed origins are read from the QI ecosystem registry, never hardcoded — new QI projects are trusted automatically.
features.notes: qi_registry.cors_origins(); safe fallback to known QI ports

features.name: 24/7 service + public tunnel
features.description: Runs as the QI_NEXUS Windows service and is reachable remotely via a Cloudflare tunnel.
features.notes: NSSM QI_NEXUS + QI_NEXUSTunnel

features.name: QI Brain logging
features.description: Register NEXUS sessions and decisions in the QI Brain for cross-project memory.
features.notes: Not yet wired

features.name: Multi-user release hardening
features.description: API authentication, rate limiting, and per-user session isolation for use beyond the local machine.
features.notes: Currently single-user / local-only
